name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination with aerodynamics, fueled by watching fighter jets soar through the skies. He pursued a degree in aerospace engineering, followed by a PhD specializing in computational fluid dynamics. Before joining Williams Racing, Park spent two decades at Hyundai Motor Company, leading their aerodynamic research division and contributing significantly to the design of their high-performance vehicles. 

As Head of Aero, Park believes in a holistic approach, emphasizing the synergy between CFD simulations, wind tunnel testing, and on-track data analysis. He's a firm believer in empowering his team, fostering a collaborative environment where innovation thrives. Park's meticulous attention to detail, combined with his ability to see the big picture, makes him a valuable asset to the team, always pushing the boundaries of aerodynamic performance.
